text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide gave the best performance 
she could at that moment, yet she was 
defeated in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the Trainer feels frustrated, 
thinking that if only the venue hadn't 
been changed, they could have improved the 
precision of their "equation" and secured 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even Biwa Hayahide was not satisfied with 
the status quo. She needed to reach the 
pinnacle of her generation and eventually 
defeat her younger sister—Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her goal: the Takarazuka Kinen, where the 
chosen Umamusume gather. To foster further 
growth, she moved forward with her 
preparations.
